title: Electricity is up 900% since 2007 #Eskom
text:
Nomsa (an illustration) buys the same R500 of electricity every month, and in July she gets fewer units. Since 2007, electricity prices in South Africa have gone up by about 900%, while prices in general rose by about 150%. So how did Eskom end up so deep in debt that the government stepped in with up to R254 billion?

Full guide: "How Eskom Went Broke, and What It Costs You Every Month (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.

Sources
- Electricity Minister Kgosientsho Ramokgopa, 18 Aug 2026 (prices since 2007)
